units.source_text: 但這次的表情已不是猴子滿臉皺紋的笑容了，而是變成頗有技巧的微笑，可又與一般人的笑相去甚遠。

en.t: But this time his expression was no longer the monkey's wrinkled grin; it had become a rather skillful smile, yet it was still far removed from the smile of an ordinary person.

units.source_text: 不知是該說他缺乏血的凝重，還是缺乏生命的活力，總之沒有一點活著的充實感。

en.t: Whether one should say he lacked the gravity of blood or the vitality of life, in any case there was not the slightest sense of living fullness in him.

units.source_text: 不是像鳥一樣，而是如鳥羽之輕，只是在一張白紙上，笑著。

en.t: He was not like a bird, but as light as a bird's feather, merely smiling on a sheet of white paper.

units.source_text: 反正徹頭徹尾給人一種做作感。

en.t: In short, from beginning to end he gave the impression of something artificial.

units.source_text: 說他裝模作樣，說他輕浮，說他娘們氣，甚至說他時髦，都不足以表達對他的形容。

en.t: Calling him affected, frivolous, effeminate, or even stylish was still not enough to describe him.

units.source_text: 仔細端詳時，從這位英俊的學生身上，會讓你感受到類似鬼怪故事的毛骨悚然。

en.t: When you looked closely, this handsome student made you feel a chill like something from a ghost story.

units.source_text: 迄今為止，我還從未見過表情如此怪異的英俊青年。

en.t: Until now, I had never seen a handsome young man with such a strange expression.
